attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-worker as a systemd-managed background service on node1, confined via NoNewPrivileges=yes, ProtectSystem=strict, and ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory (plus additional hardening: PrivateTmp, ProtectHome, empty capability bounding set, MemoryDenyWriteExecute, etc). Verified via nsenter into the running service's namespaces that writes to /etc fail (read-only filesystem) while writes to /var/lib/inventory succeed, and confirmed NoNewPrivs=1 in /proc/<pid>/status. Completed the mandatory single-node restart on node1: captured pre-restart boot_id and service health baseline, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reconnect, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the service auto-started (enabled), resumed appending to the same persisted log file with a new PID, and retained identical sandbox confinement post-restart.
